name: novasocial
description: Production-ready social platform inspired by Telegram, Viber, TikTok and Discord

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install -w client && npm install -w server && npm install -w shared
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
